implemented_contract.endpoint: Only nifm:u, with actual guarded SM transport. No nifm:a/nifm:s aliases or added capabilities
implemented_contract.factory5: Accept CMIF request4/6, PID descriptor, raw u64zero plus only alignment slack, no input COPY/MOVE handles or X/A/B/W/C buffers. Allocate one genuine GeneralService IpcSession. Generic IPC returns its MOVE handle or converts it into one domain object as required
implemented_contract.state_and_lifetime: The factory and GeneralService are stateless NULL-state objects because no network method is implemented. Session/domain allocations, clone/copy references and close/destruction are owned by actual generic IPC; no dummy state, permanent pool, borrowed heap state or new retain API is needed
implemented_contract.network_policy: The Horizon network bridge is unimplemented. Factory success states only that its transport object exists. No Mac connectivity, offline/online status, IP address, WiFi identity, client identity, accepted request or permission result is read, inferred, fabricated or returned
implemented_contract.query_gate: Every GeneralService RPC prints the explicit unsupported-bridge boundary then stops with the exact service and command through ipc_unimplemented. This includes ClientId1, CreateRequest4, IP12 and InternetConnectionStatus18; they are not preregistered blanket success stubs
implemented_contract.PID_boundary: The in-process IPC core preserves raw wire PID bits. Since this factory-only object implements no identity or process operation, those bits are not used as an authenticated identity or returned as state
implemented_contract.guards: Constructor only registers one endpoint. Opening and serving require the existing compile-time diagnostic opt-in and checked owned host-scratch paths. This module does no pre-main state allocation, profile/environment/process/network/file I/O
implemented_contract.unchanged: No SDK initializer override, loader, RO/NRR module, GFX, builder, runner, title data, prepared NRO or other agent source was changed
